s.how: Heat a greased 25cm pan in the oven at 210C. Mix 200g cornmeal, 125g flour, 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt with 350ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 80g melted butter. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes, then cut into squares and serve with butter.

s.note: the beach town Andy dreams about
s.how: Mash 3 ripe avocados roughly with the juice of 2 limes and salt. Stir in half a finely diced red onion, 1 diced jalapeño and a handful of chopped coriander. Serve straight away with 230g warm corn chips.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches, then soften 2 onions. Return the beef with 2 tbsp flour, 750ml beef stock, 600g potatoes and 3 carrots in chunks. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender. Ladle into bowls with thick white bread.

w.note: a nod to the little rock hammer
w.how: Melt 400g milk chocolate gently. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted peanuts and 100g broken plain biscuits. Spread into a lined 20cm tin, chill 2 hours until set and cut into rough rocks.

d.note: the tarring crew's beers on the roof
d.how: Chill 4 bottles of lager and 2 bottles of ginger beer for at least 3 hours. Hand them out cold, the way the tarring crew got theirs on the roof, sitting in the sun.
